instrument: B&K Precision DC electronic load (8600 series)
source: Transcribed from the B&K Precision 8600 Series Programmable DC Electronic Load Programming Manual. The level-setting commands are supplemented by hand: the guide prints them only in a right-hand 'Command Syntax' column whose entry carries no prose of its own. Cross-checked against pymeasure bkprecision and the Siglent SDL1000X set, which follows the same SCPI structure.

supplements.description: Select the input regulation mode of the electronic load: CURRent, VOLTage, RESistance or POWer.
Query the input regulation mode of the electronic load.
Set the current the load draws in constant-current mode.
Set the voltage the load holds in constant-voltage mode.
Set the resistance the load presents in constant-resistance mode.
Set the power the load dissipates in constant-power mode.
Query whether the load input is on. The INPut and OUTPut commands are equivalent.
